appTagline: Assess the health of your public GitHub repository in one click.
heroSubtitle: 100% in-browser, no sign-up, zero tracking, and no external dependencies.
error_not_found: Repository not found. Public GitHub repositories only.
error_rate_limit: GitHub API rate limit exceeded (60 req/h unauthenticated). Please try again later.
error_network: Network error: unable to reach GitHub API. Check your connection.
error_forbidden: Access forbidden by the GitHub API.
report_analysis_unavailable: Analysis impossible: insufficient data for this repository.
report_security_warning: This score is a decision aid. It does not replace human code review or a professional security audit.
check_cicd_workflows_present: At least one GitHub Actions workflow configured
check_cicd_multiple_workflows: At least two GitHub Actions workflows configured
check_cicd_tests: Workflow dedicated to automated tests or CI
check_security_no_secrets: No exposed secrets or credentials at root
check_security_license: Formal open source license attached to repository
check_activity_recent_commit: Latest commit pushed within the last 30 days
check_activity_commit_90d: Latest commit pushed within the last 90 days
check_activity_regular_6m: Steady activity (at least 12 commits over 6 months)
check_activity_recent_release: At least one release published in the last 12 months
check_activity_recent_closed_issue: At least one issue resolved in the last 90 days
check_community_contributors_2: At least 2 active contributors on the repository
check_community_contributors_5: At least 5 active contributors on the repository
check_community_bus_factor: The lead contributor does not represent more than 70% of the total contribution volume
check_community_issue_template: An issue template is available for the community
check_community_pr_template: A pull request template is available
check_community_response_time: Average issue response time is below 30 days
check_community_external_closed: At least one closed issue was resolved by an external contributor
check_quality_tests_dir: Tests directory present (tests/, test/, spec/ or __tests__)
check_quality_test_config: Test configuration detected (Jest, Vitest, Mocha, Pytest, node:test, Playwright, PHPUnit)
check_quality_coverage: Coverage configuration or reporting setup present
check_quality_structure: Clear project structure with at least 2 folders among src/, lib/, app/, packages/, modules/
check_quality_types: Type checking or declaration files detected
check_hygiene_description: Repository description is detailed and meaningful
check_hygiene_topics: At least 3 topics are associated with the repository
check_hygiene_no_binaries: No large binary artifact found at the repository root
check_hygiene_homepage: Homepage or project website is configured
check_hygiene_not_fork: Repository is a primary project, not a fork
rec_readme_present: Add a README.md at repository root to introduce the project.
rec_readme_substantial: Expand the README (> 800 characters) with a detailed overview and setup instructions.
rec_readme_structured: Structure the README with clear section headings (# and ##).
rec_readme_examples: Add concrete code or usage snippets inside the README.
rec_license: Add a LICENSE file at root to define distribution and reuse rights.
rec_contributing: Add a CONTRIBUTING.md file to guide potential contributors.
rec_code_of_conduct: Add a CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md file to set community standards.
rec_support: Add a SUPPORT.md file explaining where and how to get help.
rec_changelog: Maintain a CHANGELOG.md file to trace releases and evolution.
rec_cicd_workflows_present: Create your first workflow in .github/workflows/ to automate tests or builds.
rec_cicd_multiple_workflows: Add specialized workflows to isolate CI tests and publishing pipelines.
rec_cicd_tests: Add an automated testing workflow (e.g., npm test, pytest) running on each PR.
rec_cicd_lint: Set up a linting workflow to enforce consistent code styling and quality.
rec_cicd_release: Automate releases or package publishing using dedicated workflows.
rec_cicd_dependabot: Add a .github/dependabot.yml file to monitor dependencies automatically.
rec_cicd_renovate: Configure Renovate Bot to streamline dependency management.
rec_security_md: Add a SECURITY.md file explaining your responsible vulnerability disclosure process.
rec_security_dependabot: Enable Dependabot configuration to automate security vulnerability alerts.
rec_security_no_secrets: Remove all secret and credential files (.env, credentials) immediately from the repository.
rec_security_license: Attach an official open source license (MIT, Apache, etc.) to the project.
rec_security_not_archived: This project is archived and no longer receives maintenance or security updates.
rec_security_documented: Include a security guidelines or vulnerability reporting section in the README.
rec_activity_recent_commit: Commit updates regularly to demonstrate ongoing project maintenance.
rec_activity_commit_90d: No commit for over 3 months: schedule a project update.
rec_activity_regular_6m: Maintain a consistent contribution rhythm (at least 12 commits over 6 months).
rec_activity_recent_release: Publish a fresh release or tag to indicate progress and stability.
rec_activity_issue_close_rate: Address and close obsolete or solved issues (aim for a > 50% closure rate).
rec_activity_recent_closed_issue: Actively resolve and close community issues on a regular basis.
rec_community_contributors_2: Bring in more contributors or open the project to wider participation to strengthen the community.
rec_community_contributors_5: Invite more contributors and diversify the maintainership footprint.
rec_community_bus_factor: Distribute project ownership among several maintainers to reduce reliance on a single contributor.
rec_community_issue_template: Create an issue template to help users report bugs and requests with clear structure.
rec_community_pr_template: Add a pull request template to standardize contribution quality and review flow.
rec_community_response_time: Reduce the average issue response time by scheduling periodic triage and clearer labels.
rec_community_external_closed: Encourage external contributors to resolve and close relevant issues in a more active way.
rec_quality_tests_dir: Add a dedicated tests folder (tests/, test/, spec/, or __tests__) to protect future changes.
rec_quality_test_config: Add a project-specific test configuration (Jest, Vitest, Mocha, Pytest, or node:test) to automate validation.
rec_quality_coverage: Set up code coverage reporting to track which parts of the project are exercised by tests.
rec_quality_linter: Add a linter to catch quality issues and enforce a consistent coding style.
rec_quality_formatter: Add an automatic formatter to normalize style and reduce review churn.
rec_quality_structure: Organize the repository into clearer directories (src/, app/, lib/, packages/, modules/) to improve maintainability.
rec_quality_types: Add type checking or declaration files to make the codebase more robust and self-documenting.
rec_hygiene_gitignore: Add a .gitignore file to exclude build fragments and sensitive files from version control.
rec_hygiene_description: Write a repository description longer than 20 characters to improve discoverability.
rec_hygiene_topics: Assign at least 3 topics to the repository to improve discoverability on GitHub.
rec_hygiene_size: Reduce repository size or remove large artifacts to keep the project maintainable.
rec_hygiene_no_binaries: Remove large binary files from the repository root to keep the project clean and lightweight.
rec_hygiene_homepage: Add a homepage or project site to present the work more clearly to visitors.
rec_hygiene_not_fork: Use a primary repository instead of a fork to retain project ownership and contribution flow.
